info.title: d365kb
info.description: Internal knowledge base for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, covering all functional modules. Structured AOT metadata: tables (fields, EDTs, keys, indexes, relations), classes and methods (with source), enums, labels, data entities, module composition, and label resolution, plus a hallucination check to validate object/field claims.

post.description: D365FO metadata knowledge base. Use this tool when the user asks about: table structure (fields, types, EDTs, keys, indexes, relations and join keys), enum values, whether a field exists, class methods and X++ method source, data-entity sources, module composition, label text behind @SYS IDs, or to validate that a table/field/object actually exists (hallucination check). Do NOT use for who-calls-what (use d365-xref), permissions (use d365-sec), or live transactional data.
